_comment: Review decisions for the SLFS subset, applied by bin/extract-slfs.py.
Same contract as recipes/review-overrides.json: drop / replace / enable / defer.
SLFS has no downloadable pre-built chunked HTML (unlike LFS/BLFS) -- pages are
fetched one at a time from linuxfromscratch.org's own view/<ver>/ path into
book/slfs-<ver>/ as each package needs one. Markup differs from LFS/BLFS in one
way, checked directly against real pages: SLFS marks an admonition with a bare
class (e.g. class="note") rather than "admon note", and marks root-only commands
with <pre class="root">, same as BLFS -- both handled by bin/booklib.py.
